locative plural indicating the large number in which torment occurs
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device) in locative plural

items.question: Within what vast array of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number involved is eighty-four thousand.
These are womb-mechanisms or matrices of birth.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across the full expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly named in this verse and must be supplied from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
